_about: Plain-English meanings for every ability name EA's Madden 27 feed uses on this page. Written for a ten-year-old; the game's own wording is longer. X-Factor = a star's signature power that switches on once he gets hot in a game (a few big plays), then he's nearly unstoppable at that one thing until the other team cools him off. Superstar = always on, a steady boost.

xfactor.Double Me: He wins jump balls. Throw it up to him one-on-one and he'll go get it — the defense basically has to double-team him.
xfactor.Shutdown: A lockdown corner. Receivers can't shake him and he wins the tight battles in man coverage.
xfactor.Unstoppable Force: A pass rusher who blows past blockers with power moves — offensive linemen just can't hold him.
xfactor.Reinforcement: A hitter. When he arrives, receivers drop the ball — his hits knock passes loose.
xfactor.YAC 'Em Up: Yards After Catch. Catch it, then break the first tackle and keep going.
xfactor.Run & Gun: Throws on the run like he's standing still — accurate even while scrambling.
xfactor.Bazooka: A cannon arm. He can throw the ball farther than almost anyone.
xfactor.Universal Coverage: Great in man AND zone coverage — wherever you put him, he's in the right spot.
xfactor.First One Free: The first defender to reach him always misses — he breaks that first tackle.
xfactor.Ankle Breaker: Jukes and spins so sharp that defenders fall over trying to follow him.
xfactor.Relentless: Never gets tired rushing the passer — full speed on every play.
xfactor.Freight Train: A power back. Runs through arm tackles and drags defenders with him.
xfactor.Fearmonger: Even when he doesn't get the sack, the quarterback gets rattled and throws worse.
xfactor.Dots: Pinpoint passes. He drops the ball right on the receiver's hands on tight throws.
xfactor.Dual Threat: Beats blockers with both speed and power — you never know which is coming.
xfactor.Momentum Shift: A play that flips the game — his big stop cools off the other team's stars.
xfactor.Truzz: Never fumbles. Hit him as hard as you want, he holds onto the ball.
xfactor.Pro Reads: Sees the defense like a coach — knows where the open man will be before the snap.
xfactor.Phenom: A young star who's already unstoppable — hard to bring down and hard to catch.
xfactor.Brick Wall: A quarterback who can't be knocked down — sacks and pressure barely bother him.
xfactor.Bottleneck: The safety who shuts down the middle of the field — passes over the middle get broken up.
xfactor.RAC 'em Up: Run After Catch. Every catch turns into a run — he's dangerous with the ball in his hands.

superstar.Quick Jump: Gets off the line fast — he beats press coverage right at the snap.
superstar.Edge Threat: A fast pass rusher off the edge — wins with speed around the tackle.
superstar.Lurker: Reads the quarterback's eyes and jumps routes for interceptions.
superstar.Mid Out Elite: Runs out-breaking routes in the middle range better than anyone — wins those every time.
superstar.Secure Tackler: When he wraps up, the play is over — no broken tackles.
superstar.El Toro: A bull rush that drives blockers straight backward.
superstar.Short Out Elite: Elite on short routes toward the sideline — a sure thing on quick throws.
superstar.Mid In Elite: Elite on routes that cut inside at medium depth.
superstar.Deep Out Elite: Elite on deep routes toward the sideline.
superstar.Short In Elite: Elite on short routes that cut inside — slants and quick ins.
superstar.Fearless: Throws accurately even with a defender in his face.
superstar.Unpredictable: Pass-rush moves the blocker can't guess — swims, spins, bull rushes.
superstar.Tough Nut: An offensive lineman who never gets fooled by pass-rush moves.
superstar.No Outsiders: Contains the edge — runners can't get outside of him.
superstar.Flat Zone KO: Knocks the ball loose from anyone catching it in his flat zone (near the sideline).
superstar.Short Route KO: Breaks up passes on short routes when he's covering.
superstar.Run Protector: Opens holes in the running game — a wall the defense can't push back.
superstar.Route Technician: Perfect routes — gets open on every cut.
superstar.Mid Zone KO: Knocks passes loose in the middle zone.
superstar.Sideline Deadeye: Perfect accuracy on throws toward the sideline.
superstar.Interior Threat: A pass rusher who wins up the middle, straight through the guards.
superstar.Post Up: A guard who plants himself and doesn't get moved in pass protection.
superstar.Arm Bar: Stiff-arms defenders away — one arm keeps them off him.
superstar.Juke Box: Jukes that leave defenders grabbing air.
superstar.Max Effort: Always hustling to the ball — chases plays down from behind.
superstar.Extender: Keeps plays alive — hard to sack, buys time in the pocket.
superstar.Human Joystick: Changes direction on a dime — cuts and spins like a video game.
superstar.Backfield Mismatch: A running back who's too fast for linebackers to cover on passes.
superstar.Outmatched: A linebacker who can cover tight ends and backs like a defensive back.
superstar.Nasty Streak: A mean blocker who pancakes defenders flat on their backs.
superstar.Swim Club: A swim move so quick the blocker can't get his hands on him.
superstar.Secure Protector: Never lets his man get to the quarterback.
superstar.Tank: Runs through tacklers — it takes two or three to bring him down.
superstar.Edge Protector: Locks down the edge rusher so the quarterback has time.
superstar.Threat Detector: Spots blitzes before the snap and picks them up.
superstar.Deep Route KO: Breaks up deep passes when he's in coverage.
superstar.Inside Shade: Wins when covering the inside of a receiver's route.
Buy One Get One — a pass rusher who wins with two moves in a row.
superstar.Deep Out Zone KO: Knocks passes loose in the deep sideline zone.
superstar.Runoff Elite: Elite at running defenders off — clears space downfield.
superstar.Fastbreak: A quarterback who's dangerous running the ball — fast and elusive.
superstar.Dashing Deadeye: Accurate throwing while sprinting out of the pocket.
superstar.Enforcer: Big hits that make ball carriers fumble.
superstar.Deep In Elite: Elite on deep routes that cut inside — posts and digs.
superstar.Evasive: Slippery — spins and jukes out of tackles.
superstar.Out My Way: A pass rusher who tosses blockers aside.
superstar.Screen Protector: Blocks perfectly on screen passes — gets out in front of the runner.
superstar.Pass Protector: A guard who keeps the pocket clean.
superstar.All Day: Never wears down — blocks just as well in the fourth quarter.
superstar.Run Stopper: Sheds blocks and stops the run for no gain.
superstar.Under Pressure: Gets to the quarterback when the game is on the line.
superstar.Deep In Zone KO: Knocks passes loose in the deep middle zone.
superstar.Inside Deadeye: Accurate on throws over the middle.
superstar.Gunslinger: A fast release — the ball's out before the defense can react.
superstar.No-Look Deadeye: Accurate even when he's looking somewhere else to fool the defense.
superstar.Demoralizer: His sacks and hits take the fight out of the offense.
superstar.One Step Ahead: Reads the receiver's route and gets there first.
superstar.Recuperation: Gets his energy back fast between plays.
superstar.Energizer: A running back who stays fresh — never slows down late.
superstar.Gift-Wrapped: Throws that are easy to catch — his receivers never drop them.
superstar.Extra Credit: Gets a bonus when he makes big plays — sacks and tackles for loss count extra.
superstar.Steamroller: Flattens defenders who try to tackle him high.
superstar.Deflator: His tackles knock the wind out of the ball carrier — they lose their power moves.
superstar.Instant Rebate: Gets his pass-rush moves back quicker after using them.
superstar.Reach For It: Stretches the ball over the line for extra yards and touchdowns.
superstar.Matchup Nightmare: A tight end too big for corners and too fast for linebackers.
superstar.Zen Kicker: Calm under pressure — clutch field goals don't rattle him.
superstar.Slot-O-Matic: Elite from the slot — wins routes from the inside receiver spot.
superstar.Lofting Deadeye: Accurate on high, soft touch passes over defenders.
superstar.Outside Shade: Wins when covering the outside of a receiver's route.
superstar.Clutch: Plays his best when the game is close and late.
superstar.Linchpin: The center who holds the whole offensive line together.
superstar.Goal Line Stuff: Can't be moved near the goal line — stops short runs.
superstar.Puller Elite: A guard who pulls around the edge and leads the runner.
superstar.Backlash: Punishes defenders who dive at him — breaks low tackles.
superstar.Lumberjack: Chops the ball loose — forces fumbles with his hits.
superstar.Bruiser: A punishing runner defenders don't want to tackle.
superstar.Red Zone Threat: Unstoppable near the end zone — wins the ball on scoring throws.
superstar.3rd Down Threat: The go-to guy on third down — gets open when it matters.
superstar.Bench Press: Jams receivers at the line so hard they can't get into their route.
superstar.On The Ball: Always around the football — tips, picks and pass breakups.
superstar.High Point Deadeye: Accurate on throws where the receiver has to leap for it.
superstar.Roaming Deadeye: Accurate while moving around the pocket.
superstar.Adrenaline Rush: A burst of energy after a big play — rushes even harder.
superstar.Deep Elite: Elite on go routes — the deep ball is his.
superstar.Mr. Big Stop: Comes up with the stop on the biggest plays.
superstar.Pocket Deadeye: Accurate when he stays in the pocket and sets his feet.
superstar.Medium Route KO: Breaks up passes on medium routes when he's covering.
superstar.Ironman: Never gets hurt — plays every snap.

Double Me.description: Aggressive receivers overpower defenders and attack the football. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their success rate on aggressive catches against single coverage.

Mid In Elite.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers

Runoff Elite.description: Players with this ability will distract defenders for longer with their runoffs

Mid Out Elite.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10-20 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers

Acrobat.description: Players with this ability are more likely to succeed at catching tipped passes

Quick Jump.description: Players with this ability have a slightly reduced stamina cost and slightly longer perfect window for jumping snaps.

Deep Out Elite.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 20+ yards from the LoS, outside the numbers

Bazooka.description: Quarterbacks with generational arms have the power to stretch any defense to its breaking point. When they enter the zone, their maximum throw distance is increased

Fastbreak.description: Passers with this ability receive better blocking support on designed quarterback run plays.

Dashing Deadeye.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on all unpressured throws under 40 yards while running outside the pocket (except on high throws).

Extender.description: While in the pocket, passers with this ability have a slightly improved chance to break the first sack attempt by a blitzing defensive back.

Gunslinger.description: QB has slightly increased pass anim speed when throwing under pressure.

Dots.description: Accurate passers know that ball placement is the difference between a touchdown and a turnover. When they enter the zone, all passes are thrown with elite accuracy and result in more completions

Long Range Deadeye.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on all unpressured deep throws while their feet are set (except on high throws).

No-Look Deadeye.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on all unpressured cross-body throws up to 20 yards (except on high throws).

Lofting Deadeye.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on all unpressured lob and touch throws while their feet are set (except on high throws).

Unstoppable Force.description: Elite pass rushers are a mix of strength, speed, and tenacity. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their win rate and block shed speed against one-on-one pass blocks.

Edge Threat.description: Defenders with this ability are slightly more likely to use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense, and have more favorable disengage angles.

Demoralizer.description: Defenders with this ability will cause increased fatigue penalties when tackling a ballcarrier with a hit-stick tackle.

El Toro.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to receive dominant bull rush wins when their stamina is full. This consumes a large amount of additional stamina.

Enforcer.description: Defenders with this ability allow fewer broken tackles when hit-sticking ballcarriers - regardless of the runner's size or power.

YAC 'Em Up.description: The best physical receivers don't just come down with the ball, they carry it home. When they enter the zone, they are nearly guaranteed to break their first post-catch tackle.

Deep In Elite.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 20+ yards from the LoS, inside the numbers

Short In Elite.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers

Universal Coverage.description: The most physical coverage defenders prevent catches from happening even when their target has hands on the ball. When they enter the zone, they are nearly guaranteed knockouts.

Lurker.description: Defenders with this ability can make spectacular interceptions while lurking in zones, and are more likely to attempt and succeed at diving swats/catches.

Short Route KO.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to succeed at catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus short routes less than 10 yards from the LoS

One Step Ahead.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly increased chance to react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage

First One Free.description: Some players thrive on making defenders look silly. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their fakeout rate on the next juke, spin or hurdle.

Evasive.description: Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke and spin animations.

Human Joystick.description: Ballcarriers with this ability can quickly shift momentum, change direction, and turn the corner without sacrificing speed.

Dual Threat.description: The most devastating defensive players often excel via versatility. When they enter the zone, they have an increased chance of defeating pass blocks, and knocking catches loose.

Secure Tackler.description: Defenders with this ability have an increased chance to avoid fakeouts.

Out My Way.description: Defenders with this ability will have a slightly increased chance to win impact blocks against receivers.

Recuperation.description: Players with this ability will recover from the effects of Wear and Tear and fatigue at a slightly increased rate between plays.

Screen Protector.description: Blockers with this ability will dominantly win impact blocks on screen plays

Tough Nut.description: Blockers with this ability have an increased number of blocker resistance points.

Run Protector.description: Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using most quick run block shed moves.

Route Technician.description: Receivers with this ability have a high success rate when creating separation on the last cut of any route.

Ankle Breaker.description: Truly devastating receiving threats are the ones that catch and can't be caught. When they enter the zone, they have increased fakeout rates on spin/juke/hurdle after the catch.

Backfield Mismatch.description: Running backs with this ability have slightly improved catch in traffic and route running when coming out of the backfield against linebackers and linemen.

Outmatched.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to force catch knockouts against running backs

Mid Zone KO.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to force catch knockouts and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage, less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.

Run & Gun.description: Many passers use a combination of mobility and aggressiveness to make big plays. When they enter the zone, they have elite accuracy while throwing on the run.

Sideline Deadeye.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on all unpressured throws outside the numbers (except on high throws).

Fearless.description: Passers with this ability have a reduced chance to be impacted by throw penalties caused by defensive pressure while on the run

Nasty Streak.description: Blockers with this ability will dominantly win impact blocks against linebackers and defensive backs when playing as a lineman or fullback.

Relentless.description: The most tenacious defenders beat their blocks by sheer force of will. When they enter the zone, their rush move attempts are free.

Swim Club.description: Defenders with this ability will ignore one bar of blocker resistance when attempting swim/club pass rush moves

No Outsiders.description: Defenders with this ability have slightly improved run shed moves and disengage angles for a better chance at stopping outside zone plays.

Shutdown.description: Shutdown defenders have the talent to erase receivers from the game. When they enter the zone, their coverage is tighter and interceptions are more frequent on contested catches.

Outside Shade.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly increased chance to react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and outside the numbers

Unpredictable.description: Defenders with this ability are less likely to increase their blocker's resistance bars when performing shed wins

Interior Threat.description: Defenders with this ability are slightly more likely to use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the interior of the defense, and have more favorable disengage angles.

Secure Protector.description: Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.

Short Out Elite.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers

Post Up.description: Blockers with this ability have a slightly increased chance to win any double team block they are engaged in.

Pass Protector.description: Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using most quick pass block shed moves.

Freight Train.description: Freight Trains are relentless runners who refuse to go down on first contact. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their chance to break the next tackle.

Arm Bar.description: Ballcarriers with this ability have more powerful stiff arm animations and have a larger timing window for landing perfect stiff arms

Tank.description: Ballcarriers with this ability have an increased chance to break hit-stick tackle attempts made on them.

Clutch.description: When playing from behind, players with this ability can easily enter the Zone.

Edge Protector.description: Blockers with this ability reduce an edge pass rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.

All Day.description: Blockers with this ability will allow less frequent shed attempts by their block target

Juke Box.description: Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke animations.

Energizer.description: Ballcarriers with this ability will replenish a small portion of their stamina upon successfully performing any skill move

Fearmonger.description: Some pass rushers intimidate quarterbacks with their sheer presence. When they enter the zone, they can apply significant pressure on quarterbacks even while engaged with blockers.

Inside Stuff.description: Defenders with this ability have slightly improved run shed moves and disengage angles for a better chance at stopping inside run plays.

Linchpin.description: Players with this ability grant improved blocking to the entire offensive line.

Run Stopper.description: Defenders with this ability do not need to spend stamina on shed attempts during a run play

Threat Detector.description: Players with this ability will highlight any user defenders.

Momentum Shift.description: Momentum Shift players demoralize their opponents. When they enter the zone, all on field opponents are knocked out of the zone or lose any progress towards entering the zone.

Under Pressure.description: Defenders with this ability can apply pressure to the quarterback from a slightly improved distance.

Goal Line Stuff.description: Defenders with this ability have slightly improved run shed moves and disengage angles for a better chance at stopping runs within 5 yards of the goal line.

Deep In Zone KO.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to force catch knockouts and react quicker in deep zone coverage, 20+ yards from the LoS and inside the hash marks.

Truzz.description: The most effective ball carriers prioritize maintaining possession over all else. When they enter the zone, no tackles made against them will result in a fumble.

Gift-Wrapped.description: Passers with this ability have a better chance to complete passes to uncovered halfbacks.

Extra Credit.description: Pass rushers with this ability pay a slightly reduced stamina cost for each move they attempt

Max Effort.description: Defenders with this ability will ignore one bar of blocker resistance when attempting pass rush moves with effort

Puller Elite.description: Blockers with this ability will frequently attempt slightly improved pull blocks vs. DBs

Deep Route KO.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to succeed at catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus deep routes 20+ yards from the LoS

Inside Shade.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly increased chance to react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and inside the numbers

B.O.G.O..description: Defenders with this ability are granted a free pass rush move once per play after spending stamina to perform one

Steamroller.description: Ballcarriers with this ability retain more of their forward momentum during tackles while travelling at high speeds.

Backlash.description: Ballcarriers with this ability will cause increased fatigue penalties against their tackler when tackled via a non-conservative tackle.

Reinforcement.description: The game's top defenders excel in all situations. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their chance of defeating run blocks, and disrupting catches via tackles.

Flat Zone KO.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to force catch knockouts and react quicker in any flat zone coverage, less than 10 yards from the LoS and outside the hash marks.

Lumberjack.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly increased success rate and cause more fumbles when cut-sticking ballcarriers.

Red Zone Deadeye.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on all unpressured throws while throwing in the red zone (except on high throws).

Deflator.description: Defenders with this ability will cause increased fatigue penalties when tackling a ballcarrier with a non-conservative tackle.

Instant Rebate.description: Defenders with this ability are refunded stamina when they successfully shed blocks

Deep Out Zone KO.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to force catch knockouts and react quicker in deep zone coverage, 20+ yards from the LoS and outside the hash marks.

Pro Reads.description: For great quarterbacks, vision and anticipation are paramount. When they enter the zone, their first open receiver is highlighted and they ignore defensive pressure.

Phenom.description: Some athletes defy classification as much as they defy boundaries. When they enter the zone, they are highly likely to win the first interaction they have with a defender.

Inside Deadeye.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on all unpressured throws inside the numbers (except on high throws).

Bruiser.description: Ballcarriers with this ability have more powerful truck and stiff arm animations and a larger timing window for perfect attempts.

Red Zone Threat.description: When in the red zone, receivers with this ability have a better chance to win contested catches against single coverage.

3rd Down Threat.description: On 3rd down, receivers with this ability have a better chance to win contested catches against single coverage up to 25 yards from the line of scrimmage.

Brick Wall.description: While in the pocket, passers with this ability are almost guaranteed to break the first sack attempt by any blitzing defender

Bottleneck.description: Bottleneck defenders realize that the best way to stop a route is to act early. When they enter the zone, they are highly likely to dominantly win any man press encounter.

Bench Press.description: Defenders with this ability apply bonus fatigue to their man coverage target after a successful press win

On The Ball.description: Players with this ability are much less likely to be fooled by WR runoffs

High Point Deadeye.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on unpressured high point throws under 20 yards.

Roaming Deadeye.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on all unpressured throws while their feet are set outside the pocket (except on high throws).

Reach For It.description: Ballcarriers with this ability will have a slightly reduced fumble chance while reaching for extra yards during tackles

Matchup Nightmare.description: Receivers with this ability make sharper cuts and frequently win contested catches when covered by linebackers and linemen.

Adrenaline Rush.description: Pass rushers with this ability will heal some of their fatigue after sacking the QB

Deep Elite.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 20+ yards from the LoS

Mr. Big Stop.description: Defenders with this ability will start 3rd or 4th down with slightly increased fatigue replenishment

Pocket Deadeye.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on all unpressured throws while their feet are set in the pocket (except on high throws).

RAC 'em Up.description: RAC receivers fight for every possible yard after making a catch. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their success rate on RAC catches

Zen Kicker.description: Kickers with this ability experience a slower kicking meter for better power and accuracy on kicks over 45 yards.

Medium Route KO.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to succeed at catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus medium routes 10-20 yards from the LoS

Slot-O-Matic.description: When lined up in the slot, receivers with this ability make faster cuts and have better hands when catching passes less than 8 yards from the LoS

Ironman.description: Players with this ability avoid any ratings penalties associated with playing outside of their primary position
